689:t_123:0.en:
$$シン$$
「That's right, $$デスティニー$$! You're not a power for making war! You're a power for ending war!」

689:t_123:1.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll carve out our destiny together with you! Lend me your strength, $$デスティニー$$!!」

689:t_124:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's right, $$フリーダム$$... You carry on the feelings and power of the $$ガンダム$$s that have fought alongside me.」

689:t_124:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's go! We'll fight carrying everyone's feelings and power!」

689:t_125:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「This overwhelming power...! Is this the gateway to $$シンカ$$!」

689:t_125:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「What lies beyond this... how far can I go! I want to see it!」

689:t_126:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(To me, machines... Gundams... were nothing more than tools for carrying out missions, and yet...)

689:t_126:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(...Are you the same? If the mission comes first for you too, as it does for me, then lend me that power.)

689:t_127:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「The wings of my craft have become my own...! No, I'm becoming the wings myself!」

689:t_127:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's fly! There's nothing left that can stop us now!!」

689:t_128:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「This is the best! It's not just the guitar, every single grain of sound is syncing up with me!」

689:t_128:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Listen to my song!! The super-dimensional live starts now!!」

689:t_129:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Unable to answer. However...」

689:t_129:2.en:
$$レド$$
「No, never mind... I can more or less tell without putting it into words.」

689:t_129:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit as well.」

689:t_129:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Right now, 'this unit' seems to mean both you and me.」

689:t_129:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The reasoning is unknown, but this unit judges so.」

689:t_129:6.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's do it! Right now, we go beyond machine fusion!!」

689:t_130:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「This responsiveness...! There's not the slightest loss between my movements and the AS!」

689:t_130:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have now become a perfect weapon! I will eliminate every obstacle, thoroughly!!」

689:t_131:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So the $$蜃気楼$$'s Druid System has linked directly with my brain cells...」

689:t_131:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll show you, lackeys of the $$御使い$$s! My mind now surpasses even the emissaries of God!!」

689:t_132:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
(AT... iron coffins born of the $$アストラギウス$$ Galaxy... You and I are both insignificant lives...)

689:t_132:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(But... I don't intend to die easily.)

689:t_133:0.en:
$$桂$$
「You're the best, partner! You're me, and I'm you!」

689:t_133:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Let's do this! In this multiverse, you and I are going to live to the fullest!」

689:t_134:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルゴラ$$... So Chief and $$トビー$$'s memories are inside you too.」

689:t_134:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You are $$グローリー・スター$$ itself! I'm borrowing that power from you!」

689:t_135:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「You're on fire, $$ガンレオン$$! I knew it, you hate losing too!」

689:t_135:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Go, go, Darling! Go, go, $$ガンレオン$$!!」

689:t_135:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's do it, $$ガンレオン$$! Me, $$メール$$ and you become one, burn up, and blast those guys away!!」

689:t_136:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Hold on a second, partner! If you fire up the $$ＣＤＳ$$ this freely, we'll pay for it later, and that's scary!」

689:t_136:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I know! If we combine our power, there's nothing to be afraid of!」

689:t_137:1.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Why!? Why do you reject the Captain!?」

689:t_137:2.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Are you turning your back on happiness!?」

689:t_137:3.en:
$n
「That's... not something anyone should be given...」

689:t_137:5.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「$n! You've become the Captain's enemy... I will not forgive you!」

689:t_138:1.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$, me and $$ジェニオン$$... Everything melts together and becomes something new...」

689:t_138:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But I'm not afraid... If anything, I'm excited...」

689:t_138:5.en:
$n
「We'll go beyond everything! Hope and despair, humans and machines, all becoming one!」

689:t_139:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Steel yourself, AG! Now that we've come this far, we're going to gamble!」

689:t_139:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm counting on you for the $$Ｚクリスタル$$! Stake everything on Earth if you have to, but make it succeed!」

689:t_140:0.en:
$$エスター$$
「I'll control the $$Ｚクリスタル$$! Everyone, protect the $$ソーラリアン$$, okay!」

689:t_140:2.en:
$$エスター$$
「Work and love, all out! I'm going to work with guts to make up for all the time I slept!」

689:t_140:3.en:
$$トビー$$
「What a go-getter this girl is!」

689:t_140:4.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「We can't let ourselves lose, either!」

689:t_140:5.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Understood. Let's give it everything we've got.」

689:t_140:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「We've come to a point of no return! All that's left is to keep moving forward until we drop!」

689:t_140:7.en:
$$エスター$$
「Let's go! Right now, the feelings of people all over Earth are flowing into the $$Ｚクリスタル$$!!」
